snippet.title: Kicking Back Ep 2 | Vine’s Return, Matildas Debate & Players in Goal?!
snippet.description:
Sarah Rowe is back with Melbourne City stars Aideen Keane and Taylor Ray for Episode 2 of Kicking Back, presented by Ninja! ⚽

The girls break down Matchweek 2 of the Ninja A-League, including Melbourne City's huge 5-0 win over Sydney FC, the Central Coast Mariners' flying start and the week's best goals.

Plus, the big debate: are Ninja A-League players getting a fair shot at the CommBank Matildas? Aideen and Taylor share their thoughts on playing in Australia, making the move overseas and what it takes to keep developing as a footballer.

Also on the agenda:
🔥 Inside Melbourne City's dominant performance against Sydney FC

snippet.title: Wellington Phoenix make HISTORY & What is COOKING at the Wanderers? | A-Leagues On The Whistle Ep 2
snippet.description:
Join James Dodd, Kosta Barbarouses and Roy O'Donovan on the brand new A-Leagues podcast On the Whistle, as the trio delve into the big talking points from Matchweek 2 of the A-League Men season for 2026/27.

On the menu:

🔹 Wellington Phoenix make club history, winning their opening two matches of an A-League Men season for the first time ever!
🔹 The Wanderers run riot at CommBank Stadium as they stick FIVE past reigning Champions Auckland FC - WSW were great, but what about the Black Knights?
🔹Newcastle Jets remain winless this season after drawing 1-1 with Macarthur - what's not clicking for the Jets?
🔹 The Melbourne Derby was a fiesty affair at AAMI Park that finished in a draw - who will be happier?
🔹 Sydney FC come from behind to beat Adelaide United 2-1

PLUS - Brisbane Roar opened their A-League Men season with a win over Perth Glory. The Roar were good but what's going wrong with the Glory?

What stood out to you from Matchweek 2? Let us know in the comments!

snippet.title: OFF-PITCH CUTS: EPISODE 03 ft. DANIEL GOH (BALESTIER KHALSA)
snippet.description:
Fresh trim, real talk. 💈⚽️

In Episode 3 of Off Pitch Cut, we catch up with Daniel Goh! ⚽✨

While many fall in love with football watching the English Premier League, Daniel’s love story started right under the void deck, watching neighbourhood friends,  older brothers and uncles in street soccer.

From playing under the void deck to sharpening his skills your typical co-curricular activity in school and his National Service period, Daniel made his dream a reality by becoming a professional footballer in Singapore. In this episode, he opens up about his lifelong childhood friends, his deep passion for the game, and his ultimate drive to represent the National Team once again. 🇸🇬🔥
